topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: The shadow of the past creeps closer, the footsteps echoing a rhythm I thought long faded. That voice, a ghost lingered, now guides the one I hold nearest. The shapes in the darkness seem sharper, the air, heavier. Each leaf that rustles is a whisper from before, a time marked by uncertainty and silent anguish. I watch, my muscles taut, as the child navigates the path I once tread, unaware of the shadows that loom. The trees stand silent, their branches a canopy of secrets, old and unyielding. The need to protect swells, a silent roar in the chest, a tremor in the silent stillness.
